original_alignment.interpretation: DVOL daily bars from 00:00 UTC and every retained perpetual daily bar from 08:00 UTC are checked against their 24 hourly bars. Original data vintages remain unverified.

plan.floor_policy: I retain raw predictions and count every floor hit. I don't tune the floor after scoring.

future.data_vintage: I freeze each forecast before its outcome starts. I retain the raw vintage used for its training inputs.

plan.limitations: I keep the historical all-OHLC failure and exploratory status. A future year has about 12 disjoint 30-day windows and may remain inconclusive.
plan.question: I test whether DVOL adds information to a direct 30-day HAR variance forecast.
